description: WRITE now (打刻). type is required: clock_in 出勤, clock_out 退勤, direct_in 直行, direct_out 直帰, break_start 休憩入, break_end 休憩戻. Recorded at the time Kintai Plus receives it. CANNOT be edited, deleted, or backdated — a mistake needs 修正申請 in the web UI, not another punch. Not idempotent: every successful call adds a stamp. Confirm the type with the user. Call get_today_status or close_out first. Conflicts with today (for example clock_in while already working, or clock_out while on a break) are refused; the error names the legal next type. force: true only when the user explicitly insists. If this tool is not listed, the server is read-only (KINTAI_PLUS_READ_ONLY) — tell the user, do not retry.

confirm.description: Set true to apply this write when the client cannot show a confirmation dialog. If confirmation is required and this is omitted, the tool returns a preview and changes nothing. Ignored when this call does not require confirmation.

force.description: Punch even if it conflicts with today's punch history. Use only when the user explicitly asks.

telework.description: Mark as telework (テレワーク). Only valid with clock_in.

type.description: Required. clock_in 出勤, clock_out 退勤, direct_in 直行, direct_out 直帰, break_start 休憩入, break_end 休憩戻. There is no default.

name: punch
title: Punch the time clock
